heroDescription: Create groups, add expenses, and see who owes whom — fast and fair. Perfect for trips, roommates, and group activities.

features.title: Everything you need to manage shared expenses
features.subtitle: Powerful features designed to make splitting expenses effortless and transparent

smartGroups.title: Smart Groups
smartGroups.description: Create groups for any occasion. Invite members via shareable links and keep everyone in sync with real-time balance updates.

quickExpense.title: Quick Expense Entry
quickExpense.description: Add expenses in seconds. Split equally or by custom amounts. Attach receipts and categorize for better tracking.

autoCalc.title: Auto Calculations
autoCalc.description: See who owes whom instantly. Our smart algorithm minimizes the number of transactions needed to settle up.

groups.title: Manage groups with links
groups.description: Organize trips, households, or events. Share an invite link, and keep balances visible to everyone.

expenses.title: Fast expense entry
expenses.description: Attach expenses to people and groups, split evenly or by custom shares. Edit anytime.

balances.title: Clear & settle balances
balances.description: See who owes whom across all expenses, then settle up and keep the slate clean. Multi-currency support included.
